Source: @ibravisual "CLAUDE VIDEO EDITING PACK" carousel, COMPLETE 10/10
(BULK-DECODE-LOG.md batch 19, items 1–9; slide 05/10 /effect in batch 18,
item 25). All silent, decoded from frames. Per-slide DECODE.md files:
research/video-harvest/instagram/ibravisual_DfXFz*/. He now has FOUR systems
in the harvest (JARVIS, security, /effect, Claude Video Editing Pack).

## The rule
Three steps, then type a command. Cover (DfXFzJvoDkL, 01/10): "CLAUDE VIDEO
EDITING PACK / Your new full-time video editor." + RAW vs EDITED BY CLAUDE
phone + "SWIPE TO SEE WHAT IT DOES". How it works (DfXFzJpIDbC, 02/10):
"3 steps." — 1. "Open the pack in Claude Code." (pack/ folder) / 2. "Drop
your raw clips in." (footage/ folder) / 3. "Type a command." (/edit ✓) +
"HERE ARE THE COMMANDS". Same shape as kingketo's make-one-folder +
dump-in-footage + type-one-line (batches 17–18). The folder anchor behind
the pack is davis.mcm's "skill = a folder" + Operator OS vault + AI brain
(batches 5, 13) — the richest source in the harvest: one folder per job,
one file says what it does, the rest teach it how.

## Executable steps
1. Open the pack in Claude Code (pack/ folder); drop raw clips in
   (footage/ folder). One folder per job — davis.mcm's rule.
2. Type one command at a time. /style-clone first when the style is borrowed
   (their video on top, your clip below — the clone is the match, not the
   copy); /edit for every change after ("make the captions blue" → "Done.").
3. /broll /sound last for the mix: music ducks under the voice — "MUSIC GOES
   QUIET WHEN YOU TALK" (see Needs Q's ruling — the ducking rule as PWC
   standard).
4. /trial-reels to test hooks (winner gets the green border — the A/B
   verdict is visible, not claimed); /post only after the winner is picked.
   Q's lane stays Q's: trial reels are app-only for @yerrr__q — Q posts them
   himself from the Instagram app; Muse supplies the daily three. The
   command transfers; the posting lane does not change.
5. Sibling system: @zachdoesai_'s 4-command pipeline (/clip /captions
   /storyboard /inspiration, parts/creator-systems/zachdoesai-command-catalog.md)
   is the earlier harvest system in the same shape — /clip ≈ /edit's cut,
   /storyboard ≈ the preview-and-wait gate. One canonical part per system;
   this pack is the second system, not a variant of zach's.

## Worked example (PWC)
A P-pack take: open the pack, drop the raw take in footage/. /style-clone
with P1 v9 on top, the new take below — "edit like THIS" (Q's own finished
video is the style source, never a stranger's). /edit: "captions gold on the
keyword, teal on the rest, never over my face" → "Done." /broll /sound:
punch-ins on payoff words, music ducked under the voice. /trial-reels: 4
hook variants, winner bordered. /post: Q's approval card, then Q posts (or
Muse posts the exact exported file per the standing order).

## PWC skin
Palette teal #14A886 / gold #FEE238 on navy #00214E, no red. /style-clone
source is ALWAYS Q's own finished videos (P1 v9 / P2 / P3) — never another
creator's video as the style to copy (his thumbnails show other creators'
videos; the PWC rule is Q's own work only). /faceless is NOT adopted: Q's
standard is real footage with Q on screen — the command is recorded as
observed, the format does not transfer. "HyperFrames" inside his pack
ecosystem = HeyGen's engine, NOT the workspace HyperFrames skills — do not
conflate. His CTA (10/10, comment EDIT → waitlist; "12 short classes /
Opens Tue, Nov 10 / $20 for the first 48 hours, then it doubles") is gated
and paid — NEVER chased, never bought; recorded as observed.

## Discrepancies — carried as observed, NOT reconciled
- **Slide numbering vs contact sheet:** the /broll /sound slide's contact
  sheet read "05 / 10" — the full-res frame reads "08 / 10". Full-res wins;
  the pack carousel is complete with it, not missing a slide. (Log batch 19
  lesson: verify slide numbers against full-res frames.)
- **/edit phone animates:** the /edit phone cycles through caption states
  over its 10 seconds; the settled state is quoted ("BLUE CAPTIONS / STOP
  EDITING / BUILD A TOP"). Do not quote a mid-animation frame as final.
- **Command count:** the pack shows 8 command names across 7 command slides
  (/style-clone, /edit, /effect, /faceless, /carousel, /broll, /sound,
  /trial-reels, /post — nine names on seven slides, since /broll /sound and
  /trial-reels /post share slides). Recorded as observed.

## Gaps
- **The 61 effects are a count, not a list.** Only the /effect slide (05/10)
  is in the harvest for that carousel; slides 01–04, 06–10 of the /effect
  carousel are NOT in the harvest. The 61 effect names are unknown — do NOT
  invent them. (Contrast: charliehills' 21-effect speed-run, batch 2, and
  kingketo's 15-effect catalog, batch 1, are separate counts from separate
  creators — none of the three lists is complete in the harvest.)
- **No command FILE content** (SKILL.md / scripts) for any pack command is in
  the harvest — command names + one-line jobs + trigger lines only. PWC
  command implementations must be authored from Q's rules, labeled INFERRED.
- **/faceless "4 ADD-ONS"** are unnamed on the slide — unknown what they are.
